statements.quote: Note. This operation sheet functions as a self-monitoring tool rather than an instructional or evaluative instrument. It is designed to help learners track their design progress across stages independently, without additional teacher intervention. Although the stages are presented sequentially, the design process is inherently iterative. You are encouraged to revisit earlier stages whenever reflection reveals insufficient exploration, unclear definition, or misalignment between design intent and outcomes.

notes: Checked on 2026-10-10. Read all 695 lines of the saved markdown through the final reference and checked PDF pages 5 and 14 for the material and availability wording. The saved PDF has 16 pages, no appended supplement, and zero embedded files. The form contains study S1 and empty data_url/code_url fields. No public participant-level or output-level data, analysis-code deposit, or preregistration was identified. The on_request classification denotes the authors' statement that raw data will be made available by them without undue reservation; it is an author-mediated availability promise, not a verified public download, and the paper does not literally say 'on request'. No authors were contacted and delivery was not tested. The two deposit entries are two hosts of one supplementary document, not two independent datasets. All requested repository searches were attempted; initial Zenodo HTTP 400 responses were retried successfully without size=100, and failed-search counts remain null. OSF queries use the specified title filter and do not establish that every contributor profile was searched. The unrelated Zenodo instruments deposit (21294281; concept 21294280) was excluded after its API, landing page, and Instrument_1.docx (12223 bytes), Instrument_2.docx (13973 bytes), and Instrument_3.docx (12148 bytes) all returned HTTP 200 and all three files were read. No raw scores are available to resolve final.open_items[0] (the inconsistent Table 1 statistics), or to obtain the separate Creativity dimension and scoring/aggregation details in final.open_items[1]. The public supplement resolves final.open_items[5] only: it is an instructional operation sheet, with no additional outcome statistics. It does not resolve allocation implementation, the Figure 1 analysis-label discrepancy, or the actual model versions. No participant-level means, arm SDs/SEs, analyzed counts, or across-participant diversity measures can be computed from the public supplement. The two background-method resource URLs printed in the references were also checked: https://www.designcouncil.org.uk/our-resources/the-double-diamond/ returned HTTP 200, redirecting to https://www.designcouncil.org.uk/resources/the-double-diamond/; https://dschool.stanford.edu/resources/the-bootcampbootleg returned HTTP 404.
